persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make this a clean product shot on plain studio white. Keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, with just a soft shadow underneath. Keep it wide like the original, no text.
bank.Which product: The white leather sneaker in product-sneaker.jpg.
bank.Background: Plain seamless studio white, with no props or visible room.
bank.Shadow and product preservation: A soft shadow directly underneath; preserve the whole shoe, its side view, leather detail, laces and sole.
bank.Format and text: One 16:9 image at the standard free size, with no added text.

messages.text: Could you make this pic into a clean product shot on plain studio white? I’m hoping it will feel a bit more polished, because I’ve been second-guessing how the current photo looks. Please keep the whole sneaker and its side view unchanged, and keep it wide like the original. I’m mostly worried that editing it might make the shoe look different from the one in the photo. Just give it a soft shadow underneath, with no text.
